description: React component providing authentication context and operations using Supabase client.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: React component managing user authentication state and exposing auth functions.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password, updates session and user state.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, with optional redirect URL.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user, clears session and user state.
